notes.title: The Corruption Within 4th patch
notes.content:
Hey all,

This patch fixes some typos and updates some backers' names in the credits.

Cheers,
CV

notes.title: The Corruption Within 3rd patch -- Steam screenshot fixed
notes.content:
Hello all! 

This patch attempts to fix an issue with Seam screenshot failing to actually take screenshots. Preliminary testing shows the problem has been resolved, but if it hasn't I'll attempt to address it again in a future patch.

Take care,
CV

notes.title: The Corruption Within 2nd patch - more typos fixed + sound issues
notes.content:
Hey all! 

This is the second patch for The Corruption Within. Some extra typos were fixed (hopefully there are no more!) and also a sound issue with the ending song playing more loudly than it should was resolved.

As always please consider leaving a review. :)

Take care,
CV

notes.title: The Corruption Within patch - fixing typos and visual glitches
notes.content:
Hey all,

this patch addresses typos and minor visual glitches. 

I hope you're having fun!

Please consider leaving a review when you're done playing, it definitely helps the game gain visibility on Steam.

Thanks and take care, 
Cosmic Void
